Package dev.px.core.integration

Class IntegrationService

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.setting.SettingHolder
dev.px.core.integration.IntegrationService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Named, Service
public final class IntegrationService extends SettingHolder implements Service
Drives the optional external integrations: rich presence and now-playing.

Both are polled or pushed on the thread pool, never on the game thread. The old client ran Discord RPC on its own manager and Spotify on another, each with bespoke threading, and both were commented out in the end.

Neither provider is required. With none installed the settings are still present and the service does nothing, so the client behaves identically with and without them.

      public Class<? extends Service>[] dependsOn()
      Description copied from interface: Service
      Services that must be started before this one.

      Declare what you actually read during Service.start(), not everything you eventually touch: a dependency only needs to exist before startup, and over-declaring creates cycles that are not really there.
